title: The SDK picks up audio, uploads, and account tools
summary:
The SDK gained transcription, uploads, and account tools, while media filenames and Step 3.5 Flash requests got sorted out.

@pollinations_ai/sdk 4.1.0 adds audio transcription, media uploads, Bring Your Own Pollen authorization URLs, and helpers for profiles, balances, usage, and API key validation.

Uploaded filenames now affect content-addressed URLs and appear in download headers. Re-uploading a file refreshes its 14-day retention period; the incompatible DELETE endpoint was removed.

The text backend now recognizes the already-registered `step-3.5-flash` model, fixing requests that previously returned 404.

highlights.title: Transcribe audio from the SDK
highlights.text: Use `transcribe()` to send audio to the transcription API, with options for model, language, and response format. [Get the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: Upload media from the SDK
highlights.text: Use `upload()` for images, audio, or video and get back a public media URL. [Get the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: Build wallet authorization links
highlights.text: Use `authorizeUrl()` to create Bring Your Own Pollen authorization links scoped by model, budget, and permissions. [Get the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: Check accounts from the SDK
highlights.text: Retrieve profiles, Pollen balances, and usage, or validate an API key to inspect its permissions, budget, and expiry. [Get the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).
